name: MEDIFIT
summary:
Ride to the beat, sweat it out, and have fun!

MEDIFIT lets you start right away without any sensors or extra equipment.

With just a controller, you can ride on any indoor bike and
enjoy rhythm fitness and rehab exercises comfortably using only your body.

**Key Features**

🚴‍♀️ Bike – Cycle indoors to a variety of K-Pop tracks! Hit your target speed, 
race alongside pacemakers, and enjoy nonstop immersion.

🩺 Rehab Fitness – Follow guided programs, track your progress, and recover step by step.
